facts.title: If God knew Samson would throw it all away, why did He give him so much strength?

items.msg: first VO line equals the title
'all' — make sure the text really says this: 'If God knew Samson would throw it all away, why did He give him so much strength'
'only' — make sure the text really says this: 'Samson's choices cost him his eyes. But at the end, he prayed, "strengthen me on'
answer stated in the Turn/Landing: 'God didn't give Samson strength because he deserved it. He gave it because Israel needed saving.'
